newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece cuts T-bill rates, FRN spreads - source.
newsitem.headline: Greece cuts T-bill rates, FRN spreads - source.

text.p: Greece shaved 10 basis points off the spreads of three-, five- and seven-year floaters to 40, 90 and 140 basis points, respectively, a moneatry source told Reuters.

It had also cut three-, six- and 12-month T-bill rates to 11 percent, 11.30 percent and 12 percent from 11.50 percent, 11.70 percent and 12.30 percent, respectively, effective November 12, the source said.
Three-, five- and seven-year floaters will be refixed on Friday. Coupons of Greek FRNs are based on the benchmark 12-month T-bill rate plus a spread.
This means the refixing of FRN coupons on Friday will be based on the 12-month T-bill rate of 12 percent rather than the end-October 12-month T-bill rate of 12.30 percent.

"If this is true, the treasury has chosen to violate the FRNs terms stated in writing," said an angry dealer. "I just hope this piece of information is incorrect." --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
